name: 3DFace
description: Creates a single mesh face from three or four picked corner points.

menu: Mesh | Append Face | Polygon Mesh Primitives > 3‑D Face | SubD | Append Face | Primitives > 3‑D Face

name: 3View
description: Switches the workspace to a three-viewport layout.

name: 4View
description: Switches the workspace to the four-viewport layout.

name: About
description: Opens the About panel showing version and licence information.

name: AcadSchemes
description: Chooses which DWG/DXF release Export and Save As write, through the Version option.

name: AddGuide
description: Stores a two-point construction guide line in the document.

name: AddMissingBlockAttributeKeys
description: Adds empty user-text keys, given as Keys=a,b, to block instances and to their definition.

name: AddNextU
description: Extends the control-point selection by one step in the surface U direction.

name: AddNextV
description: Extends the control-point selection by one step in the surface V direction.

name: AddNgonsToMesh
description: Merges connected coplanar mesh faces into single n-gon faces.

name: AddObjectsToBlock
description: Puts selected objects into a block definition that already exists.

name: AddPrevU
description: Extends the control-point selection by one step backward in the U direction.

name: AddPrevV
description: Extends the control-point selection by one step backward in the V direction.

name: AddToGroup
description: Adds selected objects to an existing group.

name: Alerter
description: Toggles a beep that sounds when a command finishes.

name: Align
description: Aligns selected objects to one another by bounding-box sides or centers, or to the construction plane.
toolbars: Align and Distribute, Main, Main2, Transform, SubD Sidebar

name: AlignProfiles
description: Reverses curves and moves closed-curve seams to match the first profile, ready for lofting.

name: AlignVertices
description: Merges mesh vertices closer together than a given distance, placing them at their average position.
menu: Mesh / SubD | Repair Tools > | Align Vertices

name: Angle
description: Reports the angle between two picked directions measured at a vertex point.

name: ApplyBoxMapping
description: Assigns box texture mapping to the selected objects.

name: ApplyCrv
description: Alias of Flow: carries objects from a base curve onto a target curve.
menu: Curve | Curve from Objects > | Apply UV Curves

name: ApplyCustomMapping
description: Assigns texture mapping from a custom frame defined by a picked origin and X-axis point.

name: ApplyCylindricalMapping
description: Assigns cylindrical texture mapping to the selected objects.

name: ApplyMesh
description: Maps a mesh onto a matching target mesh using nearest-triangle barycentric positions and a normal offset.

name: ApplyMeshUVN
description: Same mapping as ApplyMesh; meshes here carry no separate texture-coordinate channel, so UVN gives identical results.

name: ApplyOcsMapping
description: Maps selected objects out of their own object coordinate system with the arbitrary-axis algorithm.

name: ApplyPlanarMapping
description: Assigns planar texture mapping to the selected objects.

name: ApplySphericalMapping
description: Assigns spherical texture mapping to the selected objects.

name: ApplySurfaceMapping
description: Assigns surface-based texture mapping to the selected objects.

name: Arc
description: Draws an arc from center, start and end points.

name: ArcBlend
description: Joins two curve ends with a pair of tangent arcs, falling back to one arc when tangents are near parallel.

name: Area
description: Reports the total area of selected surfaces, polysurfaces or meshes.

name: AreaCentroid
description: Reports the area centroid of selected surfaces or meshes.

name: AreaMoments
description: Reports the area moments of selected surfaces or planar curves.

name: Array
description: Copies objects into a grid of rows, columns and levels with chosen spacing.
toolbars: Array, Main, Main1, Transform, SubD Sidebar

name: ArrayCrv
description: Copies objects at a set number of positions along a path curve, with orientation options.

name: ArrayCrvOnSrf
description: Copies objects along a path curve lying on a surface, oriented by the surface normal.

name: ArrayHole
description: Cuts a rectangular grid of holes into solids, with round or profile-shaped holes.
menu: Solid | Solid Edit Tools > | Holes > | Array Hole

name: ArrayHolePolar
description: Cuts a circular pattern of holes into solids, with round or profile-shaped holes.

name: ArrayLinear
description: Copies objects in a straight line at a set count and spacing.

name: ArrayPolar
description: Copies objects around a center point at a set count and total angle.

name: ArraySrf
description: Copies objects across a surface in a grid of U and V positions.

name: Arrowhead
description: Sets arrowheads of a chosen size at the start, end or both ends of selected curves.

name: AssignBlankTexture
description: Assigns a neutral generated checker texture to the selected objects' materials at a chosen resolution.

name: AttachGHSData
description: Attaches flow-graph data to selected objects.

name: Audit
description: Scans the document for invalid objects and lists the problems found in the audit results panel.

name: AutoAlignCPlane
description: Toggles whether the construction plane follows the view orientation automatically.

name: AutomaticSubDFromMesh
description: Converts selected meshes to SubD using an angle threshold, optionally deleting the input meshes.

name: Autosave
description: Writes the current document to an autosave file in the configuration folder.

name: BackgroundBitmap
description: Places, aligns or removes a viewport's background picture, with grayscale and filter options.

name: Bake
description: Bakes procedural textures on the selected objects into image textures.

name: BakeMapping
description: Bakes each selected object's texture mapping into its own geometry.

name: BatchRenderNamedViews
description: Renders named views one after another to image files at the chosen quality.

name: Bend
description: Bends objects along a spine defined by start, end and bend-through points.

name: Blend
description: Creates a blend curve between two curve ends, with a continuity choice.

name: BlendCrv
description: Creates a blend curve joining two curve ends.
menu: Curve | Blend Curves > | Adjustable Curve Blend

name: BlendEdge
description: Replaces selected solid edges with a Hermite blend surface that is trimmed and joined in.

name: BlendSrf
description: Builds a Hermite blend surface between two picked surface edges, with a continuity option.

name: Block
description: Stores the selected geometry as a named block definition.

name: BlockEdit
description: Places an editable copy of a block definition; running it again redefines the block.

name: BlockManager
description: Opens the block panel, or lists the document's block definitions on the command line.

name: BlockResetScale
description: Re-inserts block instances at their insertion points without any scaling.

name: Boolean2Objects
description: Combines two sets of objects; the Result option cycles union, intersection, A-B, B-A or symmetric difference before Enter commits.

name: BooleanDifference
description: Subtracts the second set of solids from the first set.

name: BooleanIntersection
description: Keeps only the volume shared by the selected solids.

name: BooleanSplit
description: Splits solids with a plane through two picked points, perpendicular to the construction plane.

name: BooleanUnion
description: Merges the selected solids into one solid.

name: Boss
description: Extrudes a closed footprint curve along the surface normal at sample points to make a solid.

name: Bounce
description: Traces a ray from a start point and direction, reflecting it off surfaces a set number of times.

name: BoundingBox
description: Creates a box enclosing the selected objects and reports its extents.

name: Box
description: Creates a box from base corners and a height.
toolbars: Box, Main, Main1, Solid Creation, Solids Sidebar

name: BoxEdit
description: Opens the box-edit panel.

name: Bridge
description: Joins two SubD faces with a connecting tube of faces.

name: BringForward
description: Moves the selected objects one step forward in draw order.

name: BringToFront
description: Moves the selected objects to the front of the draw order.

name: BringViewportToTop
description: Raises a named viewport window above the other viewports.

name: Cage
description: Creates a deformation cage box with chosen divisions around a picked region.

name: CageEdit
description: Deforms captive objects by moving the control points of a cage.
toolbars: Cage, Deformation Tools, Transform, SubD Sidebar

name: Calc
description: Evaluates a typed arithmetic expression and prints the result.

name: CalcRPN
description: Evaluates a postfix expression with an operand stack and prints the result.

name: Camera
description: Shows the active camera and its view frustum, and lets you pick a new camera location and target.
menu: View / Viewport title | Set Camera > | Show Camera

name: Cancel
description: Explains how to cancel the running command; typing Cancel or pressing Esc stops it.
toolbars: Collapse Mesh, Curve Drawing, Extract Mesh, Main, Main1, Render Sidebar, Solids Sidebar, Surface Sidebar, SubD Sidebar

name: Cap
description: Closes open planar boundaries of selected surfaces with planar caps to form a solid.

name: Catenary
description: Draws a hanging-chain curve between two points, from a through-point or a given mode.

name: Centermark
description: Adds a center mark to a selected circle or arc, kept associative to it.

name: Chamfer
description: Bevels the corner between two curves with chosen distances.

name: ChamferEdge
description: Bevels selected solid edges with chosen distances.

name: ChamferSrf
description: Creates a ruled bevel surface between two surfaces with chosen distances.

name: ChangeDegree
description: Raises the degree of curves or surfaces to a typed target; it never lowers degree.

name: ChangeLayer
description: Moves the selected objects to a chosen layer.

name: ChangeSpace
description: Moves selected objects between model space and the active layout by tagging or untagging them with the layout name.

name: ChangeToCurrentLayer
description: Moves the selected objects onto the current layer.

name: Check
description: Checks selected objects for validity and reports the reason for each invalid one.
toolbars: Analyze, Diagnostics, Geometry Fix, Main, Main2, Mesh Tools

name: CheckInLicense
description: Prints a message that Dino 8 is free software and needs no licence.

name: CheckNewObjects
description: Switches automatic validity checking of newly created objects on or off.

name: CheckOutLicense
description: Prints a message that Dino 8 is free software and needs no licence.

name: Circle
description: Draws a circle from a center and radius, with diameter, three-point and tangent options.

name: Clash
description: Finds clashes between selected objects within a clearance distance and can build the overlapping solids.

name: ClearAllMeshes
description: Discards cached display meshes for every object so they are rebuilt on demand.

name: ClearAllObjectDisplayModes
description: Clears per-object analysis, edge and control-point display settings on all objects.

name: ClearAnalysisMeshes
description: Discards display and analysis meshes of surface objects so they are regenerated.

name: ClearClippingSections
description: Deletes the section curves created by ClippingSections.

name: ClearDrawOrder
description: Resets the selected objects to the default draw order.

name: ClearUndo
description: Erases the undo history.

name: ClippingDrawings
description: Draws each enabled clipping plane's section curves onto a dedicated layer for later update or export.

name: ClippingPlane
description: Creates a clipping plane from two corner points, with options for depth, name and label.

name: ClippingPlaneProperties
description: Opens the clipping-planes panel.

name: ClippingSections
description: Creates section curves where the enabled clipping planes cut the model.
toolbars: Clipping section creation, Drafting, New in V8, Sections

name: CloseCrv
description: Closes open curves, optionally bridging wide gaps with a line within a tolerance.
menu: Curve | Curve Edit Tools > | Close Curve

name: CloseRenderWindow
description: Closes the render window.

name: ClosestPt
description: Finds the point on selected objects nearest a picked point, optionally drawing a line to it.

name: CloseViewport
description: Closes a named viewport, or the active one if no name is given.

name: CollapseMeshEdge
description: Collapses the mesh edge nearest a picked point to a single vertex.

name: CollapseMeshFace
description: Collapses the mesh face under a picked point to its center.

name: CollapseMeshFacesByArea
description: Collapses mesh faces whose area is below a given value to their centers.

name: CollapseMeshFacesByAspectRatio
description: Collapses the shortest edge of mesh faces whose longest-to-shortest edge ratio exceeds a given value.

name: CollapseMeshFacesByEdgeLength
description: Collapses mesh edges shorter than a given length to their midpoints.

name: CollapseMeshVertex
description: Collapses the mesh vertex nearest a picked point into its neighbors.

name: CommandHelp
description: Prints a command's description and options on the command line and opens the Help panel.

name: CommandHistory
description: Opens the command-history panel.

name: CommandList
description: Opens the command-list panel with implementation status for every command.

name: CommandPrompt
description: Shows or hides the command-line window; commands still run from menus, macros and scripts while hidden.

name: Commands
description: Opens the command-list panel.

name: ComputeVertexColors
description: Colors mesh vertices from their normals and stores the colors on the mesh.

name: Cone
description: Creates a cone from a base circle and a height.

name: Conic
description: Draws a conic section curve from start, end and apex points.

name: Connect
description: Extends or trims two curves so they meet at their planar intersection.

name: ConnectSrf
description: Extends two surfaces, trims each at their intersection curve and joins them.

name: ContentFilter
description: Filters the Materials and Textures panels to names containing the given text.

name: ContinueCurve
description: Extends a curve from its end with further picked points and joins the result into one curve.
menu: Curve | Free-Form > | Continue Control Point Curve

name: ContinueInterpCrv
description: Extends a curve from its end with interpolated points and joins the result into one curve.

name: Contour
description: Creates planar section curves or points by cutting objects with evenly spaced parallel planes.

name: Convert
description: Converts curves to polylines or arc chains within a fit tolerance, optionally deleting the input.

name: ConvertDots
description: Converts text dots into text annotations at the same positions, using the dot text.

name: ConvertExtrusion
description: Explains that Dino 8 has no separate lightweight extrusion object type, so nothing needs converting.

name: ConvertTextToBlockAttribute
description: Tags text objects as block attributes through a Key=text user-text entry.

name: ConvertToBeziers
description: Splits curves or surfaces into separate Bezier spans.

name: ConvertToSingleSpans
description: Splits curves or surfaces into single-span Bezier pieces; shares the ConvertToBeziers implementation.

name: Copy
description: Copies selected objects from a base point to one or more target points.

name: CopyCPlaneSettingsToAll
description: Applies the active viewport's construction plane settings to every viewport.

name: CopyCPlaneToAll
description: Applies the active viewport's construction plane to every viewport.

name: CopyDetailToViewport
description: Copies the camera of a layout detail to a model viewport.

name: CopyHole
description: Copies selected hole features from one point to others.
menu: Solid | Solid Edit Tools > | Holes > | Copy Hole

name: CopyLayout
description: Duplicates the active layout.

name: CopyRenderWindowToClipboard
description: Copies the last rendered image to the clipboard.

name: CopyToClipboard
description: Copies the selected objects to the clipboard.

name: CopyToLayer
description: Copies selected objects onto a named layer, creating the layer if it does not exist.

name: CopyViewportToDetail
description: Copies a model viewport's camera to a layout detail.

name: CPlane
description: Sets the construction plane from an origin and X-axis and Y-axis directions, or from a curve.

name: Crease
description: Marks selected SubD edges as creases so they stay sharp.

name: CreaseSplitting
description: Toggles whether AutomaticSubDFromMesh creases sharp edges; surfaces are not split at kinks.

name: CreateRegions
description: Creates planar regions from overlapping closed curves, including open curves whose ends meet to form closed loops.

name: CreateSolid
description: Joins surface meshes into a closed solid mesh and rejects the result if it is not watertight.

name: CreateUniqueBlock
description: Makes selected block instances use their own separate copy of the block definition.

name: CreateUVCrv
description: Draws a surface's parameter-space outline and trims flat on the construction plane, scaled to the surface's real size.
menu: Curve | Curve From Objects > | Create UV Curves

name: Crv2View
description: Builds a 3D curve from two planar curves drawn in the Top and Front views.

name: CrvDeviation
description: Measures the maximum deviation between two curves, refining samples until the result converges.

name: CrvEnd
description: Adds a point object where each selected curve ends and prints its coordinates.

name: CrvSeam
description: Moves the seam of closed curves to a picked location.
menu: Curve | Curve Edit Tools > | Adjust Closed Curve Seam

name: CrvStart
description: Adds a point object where each selected curve begins and prints its coordinates.
menu: Curve | Point Object > | Mark Curve Start

name: CSec
description: Creates cross-section curves of objects at planes spaced along a rail curve.

name: CullControlPolygon
description: Toggles the front-facing filter used when picking control points.

name: CullDegenerateMeshFaces
description: Removes zero-area or collapsed faces from selected meshes.
menu: Mesh | Edit Tools > | Cull Degenerate Mesh Faces

name: Curvature
description: Reports the curvature of a selected curve at a point.

name: CurvatureAnalysis
description: Turns on curvature false-color shading of surfaces in the viewports.

name: CurvatureAnalysisOff
description: Turns off curvature false-color shading.

name: CurvatureGraph
description: Draws an on-screen curvature comb for selected curves, with scale and density options.

name: CurvatureGraphOff
description: Removes the on-screen curvature combs.

name: Curve
description: Draws a curve from picked control points, with degree and closing options.

name: CurveBoolean
description: Combines closed planar curves into regions by union, difference, intersection or symmetric difference.
menu: Curve | Curve Edit Tools > | Curve Boolean

name: CurveThroughPolyline
description: Replaces selected polylines with a smooth cubic curve through their vertices.

name: CurveThroughPt
description: Interpolates a curve through selected point objects with a global cubic fit.

name: CurveThroughSrfControlPt
description: Builds curves through each row and column of a surface's control-point grid.

name: Cut
description: Copies selected objects to the clipboard and deletes them from the document.

name: CutPlane
description: Creates a planar surface cutting through the selected objects along a picked line.

name: CutVolume
description: Reports the volume of the selected solids lying inside the extrusion of closed planar curves.

name: Cylinder
description: Creates a cylinder from a base circle and a height.

name: DecimalPoint
description: Toggles the decimal separator of printed numbers between point and comma.

name: Delete
description: Deletes the selected objects.

name: DeleteFaces
description: Removes picked faces from a polysurface or mesh.
toolbars: Mesh Tools, Solid Tools, SubD Tools
menu: Mesh / SubD | Edit Tools > Delete Faces | Solid | Solid Edit Tools > Delete Faces

name: DeleteMeshNgons
description: Deletes the n-gon faces from selected meshes.

name: DeleteSubCrv
description: Removes a picked portion of a curve, leaving the remaining pieces.
menu: Curve | Curve Edit Tools > | Delete Subcurve

name: Detail
description: Adds a detail view to the active layout from two corner points.

name: DevLoft
description: Builds a ruled surface between two rail curves with rulings chosen to minimize twist, approximately developable.

name: Diameter
description: Reports the diameter of a picked circle or arc, optionally marking it with a dimension.

name: DigBeep
description: Toggles a terminal bell for each point digitized with the Dig commands.

name: DigCalibrate
description: Calibrates the digitizer from three points: origin, a point on the X axis and a point on the Y axis.

description: Digitizes an eye point and a target point and aims the active viewport's camera from one to the other.

name: DigClick
description: Digitizes one point and prints it without adding an object.

name: DigDisconnect
description: Disconnects the digitizer.

name: Digitize
description: Reads one point from the connected digitizer and adds it as a point object.

name: DigLine
description: Digitizes two points and joins them into a line.

name: DigPause
description: Pauses input from the digitizer.

name: DigScale
description: Sets the scale applied to raw digitizer readings before calibration.

name: DigSection
description: Digitizes a sequence of points and joins them into a polyline curve.

name: DigSketch
description: Digitizes a sequence of points into a polyline curve; behaves the same as DigSection.

name: Dim
description: Adds a linear dimension between two picked points.

name: DimAligned
description: Adds a dimension measured along the line between two picked points.

name: DimAngle
description: Adds an angle dimension from a vertex and two direction points.

name: DimArea
description: Adds a dimension showing the area of a selected object.

name: DimCreaseAngle
description: Dimensions the angle between two lines or between the first planar faces of two objects.

name: DimCurveLength
description: Adds a dimension giving a selected curve's length.

name: DimDiameter
description: Adds a diameter dimension to a selected circle or arc.

name: DimOrdinate
description: Adds ordinate dimensions showing each picked feature point's offset from a base point.

name: DimRadius
description: Adds a radius dimension to a selected circle or arc.

name: DimRecenterText
description: Rebuilds dimension text at its original default position.

name: DimRotated
description: Adds a linear dimension measured along a chosen angle.

name: DimVolume
description: Adds a dimension showing the volume of a selected solid.

name: Dir
description: Shows each curve's direction or surface's normal with arrows, and lets you flip or swap them.

name: DirectionalLight
description: Adds a directional light defined by a start point and a direction.

name: DisableClippingPlane
description: Turns off the enabled clipping planes so they stop cutting the view.

name: DisableOsnap
description: Toggles all object snaps off or back on.

name: DisplayCommandPrompt
description: Shows the command-line window.

name: DisplayProperties
description: Opens the display-properties panel.

name: Distance
description: Reports the distance between two picked points.

name: Distribute
description: Spaces selected objects evenly along the X, Y or Z direction.

name: Divide
description: Places point objects along curves by segment count or by length, with options to split and mark the ends.
menu: Curve | Point Object > | Divide Curve by > | Number of Segments | Length of Segments

name: DivideAlongCreases
description: Splits selected SubDs into separate pieces along their crease edges.
menu: Surface | Surface Edit Tools > | Divide Surface on Creases

name: DocumentProperties
description: Opens the document-properties panel.

name: DocumentPropertiesPage
description: Opens the document-properties panel.

name: DollyZoom
description: Sets a new lens length and moves the camera so the target keeps its on-screen size.
toolbars: Lens Length, Render Sidebar, Set View, View

name: Domain
description: Shows or sets the parameter domain of selected curves or surfaces.

name: Dot
description: Creates a text dot: a point object that carries a short text label.

name: DownloadLibraryTextures
description: Explains that Dino 8 has no online texture library and makes no network calls, so nothing is downloaded.

name: DraftAngleAnalysis
description: Turns on draft-angle false-color shading of surfaces relative to a pull direction.

name: DraftAngleAnalysisOff
description: Turns off draft-angle false-color shading.

name: DraftAnglePoint
description: Reports the draft angle at a picked surface point relative to the pull direction.

name: DragCopy
description: Toggles leaving a copy behind when a gumball translate drag moves the original.

name: DragMode
description: Chooses the plane in which the gumball's free handle drags: CPlane, World, UVN, View or ControlPolygon.

description: Scales gumball translate drags by a percentage, so 50 moves the selection half as far as the mouse.

description: Lowers a rectangular grid of points onto the surfaces beneath it, to build a draped mesh.

name: DrapePt
description: Projects selected point objects downward onto the objects beneath them.

name: DupAnnotationStyle
description: Duplicates an annotation style under a new name given by the NewName option.

name: DupBorder
description: Copies the outer boundary curves of selected surfaces, polysurfaces or meshes.

name: DupEdge
description: Copies selected surface or polysurface edges as curve objects.
menu: Curve | Curve From Objects > | Duplicate Edge

name: DupFaceBorder
description: Copies the boundary curves of picked faces as curve objects.
menu: Curve | Curve From Objects > | Duplicate Face Border

name: DupLayer
description: Copies the current or a named layer under a new name, optionally with its objects.

name: DupMeshEdge
description: Copies picked naked mesh edges as curves or lines.
menu: Curve | Curve From Objects > | Duplicate Mesh Edge

name: DupMeshHoleBoundary
description: Copies the boundary of each hole in selected meshes as polyline curves.
menu: Mesh | Edit Tools > | Extract > | Hole Boundary

name: EarthAnchorPoint
description: Stores a model point with its latitude, longitude and elevation in document user text.

name: Echo
description: Turns echoing of command text to the command history on.

name: EdgeContinuity
description: Measures gap, tangent angle and curvature difference between two curves or surface edges and draws markers.

name: EdgeSrf
description: Makes a surface bounded by two to four edge curves; shares the NetworkSrf implementation.

name: EditClippingDrawings
description: Selects the clipping-drawing curves so ordinary curve-editing commands can modify them.

name: EditLightByHighlight
description: Selects the light nearest a picked point so it can be edited numerically in the Lights panel.

name: EditLightByLooking
description: Aims the view through a light; Enter saves the view's eye and target back into the light.

name: EditPythonScript
description: Opens a Python file in the Script Editor panel, which runs it with the embedded interpreter.

name: EditScript
description: Opens the Lua Script Editor.

name: Ellipse
description: Draws an ellipse from its center and the end points of its two axes.

name: Ellipsoid
description: Creates an ellipsoid from a center and three semi-axis end points, or from foci.

name: EMap
description: Turns on environment-map shading analysis of surfaces.

name: EMapOff
description: Turns off environment-map shading analysis.

name: EnableClippingPlane
description: Turns on the clipping planes so they cut the view.

description: Adjusts the end tangent handle of a curve with a bulge factor, changing only the handle's length.

name: Enter

name: EnterEnd
description: Sends an Enter keypress, ending or repeating the current command step.

name: Environments
description: Sets the viewport background to a solid color, gradient, sky or spherical image environment.

name: EvaluatePt
description: Reports the coordinates of a picked point, with options to label it with a dot or leader.

name: EvaluateUVPt
description: Reports the surface point at typed U,V parameters, optionally normalized to 0-1, and can create it.
menu: Analyze | Surface > | UV Coordinates of a Point

name: Exit
description: Quits the application.

name: Explode
description: Breaks selected objects into their component parts.

name: ExplodeBlock
description: Replaces selected block instances with copies of the objects in their definition.

name: Export
description: Writes the selected objects to a file in a chosen format.

name: ExportBitmaps
description: Copies every texture used by materials into a chosen folder.

name: ExportClippingDrawings
description: Exports the clipping-plane section drawings to a file.

name: ExportClippingSectionInfo
description: Writes the clipping-section data to a text file.

name: ExportLinkedBlocks

name: ExportRuiFile
description: Writes the toolbar tabs and buttons to a small XML toolbar file.

description: Extends a curve end by a typed length.

name: ExtendSrf
description: Extends a surface edge by a given distance, with options for smooth or line extension.

description: Converts the displayed analysis mesh of selected objects into mesh objects by running Mesh.

description: Copies out surfaces that fail validity checks, checking the whole document when nothing is selected.

description: Creates section curves where the clipping planes cut the model.

description: Creates slices of the model cut by the clipping planes.

name: OptionsPage

name: PlugInManager

name: SendBackward
description: Moves the selected objects one step backward in draw order.

name: SendToBack
description: Moves the selected objects to the back of the draw order.

name: SetActiveViewport
description: Makes the viewport with a given name the active one.

name: SetCurrentRenderPlugIn
description: Reports that the built-in OpenGL renderer is the current renderer; no other renderer is available.

name: SetCustomLinetype
description: Defines a named custom linetype from a dash-and-gap pattern in model units.

name: SetDimensionLayer
description: Sets the layer on which new dimensions are created; empty means the current layer.

name: SetDisplayMode
description: Opens the display panel to choose a viewport display mode.

name: SetDocumentUserText
description: Stores a key and value in the document's user text.

name: SetFlythroughAnimation
description: Creates a fly-through animation from a camera path curve and a target path curve or fixed target point.

name: SetGroupName
description: Gives a name to the selected group.

name: SetIgesLayerLevelMap
description: Reports that IGES levels map one-to-one to layers by number; the mapping is fixed.

name: SetLayerLinetype
description: Sets the linetype of a layer by name.

name: SetLayerToObject
description: Makes the layer of a picked object the current layer.

name: SetLinetype
description: Sets the linetype of selected objects to a named linetype.

name: SetLinetypeScale
description: Sets the linetype pattern scale of selected objects.

name: SetMaximizedViewport
description: Maximizes a named viewport, or the active one, to fill the workspace.

name: SetMeshSurfaceParameters
description: Sets a per-object mesh tolerance override for selected objects, or opens Options for the global setting when none is selected.

name: SetObjectDisplayMode
description: Overrides the display mode of selected objects, such as wireframe, ghosted, X-ray, monochrome, pen or arctic.

name: SetObjectName
description: Names every selected object with a typed name, adding (2), (3) and so on when several are selected.

name: SetOneDaySunAnimation
description: Creates an animation where the sun sweeps from sunrise to sunset while the camera stays fixed.

name: SetOrtho
description: Turns Ortho mode on.

name: SetPathAnimation
description: Creates an animation moving the camera along a picked path curve toward a target.

name: SetPerFaceColorByFacePack
description: Gives each mesh face its own color by splitting vertices and storing colors per vertex.

name: SetPlanar
description: Flattens selected curves or points onto the construction plane.

name: SetPt
description: Sets the chosen world coordinates of the selected objects' points, X, Y or Z, to a target value; default Z to 0.

name: SetRedrawOff
description: Turns off viewport redrawing.

name: SetRedrawOn
description: Turns viewport redrawing back on.

name: SetSeasonalSunAnimation
description: Creates an animation where the sun's noon altitude rises from its winter low to its summer high, with a fixed camera.

name: SetSnap
description: Sets the grid snap size.

name: SetSpotlightToView
description: Aims the selected spotlights to match the active viewport's camera.

name: SetSurfaceTangent
description: Rotates a surface's edge tangent row to be tangent to a target surface without moving the edge position.
menu: Surface | Surface Edit Tools > | Set Edge Tangent Direction

name: SetTurntableAnimation
description: Creates an animation that rotates the camera around the model in a full turn.

name: SetUserText
description: Sets a user-text key and value on every selected object.

name: SetView
description: Sets the active viewport to a named standard view.
toolbars: CPlane View, Render Tools, Set View, Standard

name: SetViewToSpotlight
description: Aims the active viewport's camera along a spotlight.

name: SetWorkingFolder
description: Sets the default folder used for file dialogs and relative paths.

name: SetZoomExtentsBorder
description: Sets the margin left around objects by the zoom-extents commands.

name: Shade
description: Switches the active viewport to shaded display, with options for curves, grid and axes.

name: ShadeSelected
description: Draws selected objects shaded regardless of the viewport's display mode.

name: Shear
description: Slants objects along a direction defined by a base point and two reference points.

name: Shell
description: Hollows a closed solid to a wall thickness, optionally opening picked faces.

name: ShortPath
description: Finds a short path between two picked points over a surface, smoothed and projected back onto it.

name: Show
description: Makes every hidden object visible again.
toolbars: Geometry Fix, Hide Clusters, Organic, Popup, Standard, Visibility, Visibility

name: ShowDir
description: Displays direction arrows on selected curves.

name: ShowDirOff
description: Clears the curve direction arrows.

name: ShowEdges
description: Shows the edges of selected surfaces, polysurfaces or meshes.
toolbars: Analyze, Diagnostics, Edge Tools, Geometry Fix, Surface Tools
menu: Surface and Analyze | Edge Tools > | Show Edges

name: ShowEdgesOff
description: Hides the edge display on all objects.
toolbars: Analyze, Diagnostics, Edge Tools, Geometry Fix, Surface Tools

name: ShowEnds
description: Marks the start and end points of selected curves.

name: ShowEndsOff
description: Clears the curve end markers.

name: ShowInDetail
description: Makes hidden objects visible again in the active layout detail.

name: ShowLayersInDetail
description: Makes hidden layers visible again in the active layout detail.

name: ShowOsnap
description: Toggles the object-snaps panel.

name: ShowPt
description: Shows the control points of the selected objects.

name: ShowRenderMesh
description: Overlays the triangle edges of the render mesh on the selected objects, or on every object when none is selected.

name: ShowSelected
description: Shows every hidden object and selects it.

name: ShowSelectedInDetail
description: Shows the selected objects in the active layout detail.

name: ShowToolbar
description: Shows the toolbars.

name: ShowZBuffer
description: Toggles a grayscale depth view of the active viewport.

name: ShrinkTrimmedSrf
description: Shrinks the underlying surface of trimmed surfaces to the bounds of their trims.
menu: Surface | Surface Edit Tools > | Shrink Trimmed Surface

name: ShrinkTrimmedSrfToEdge
description: Shrinks the underlying surface of trimmed surfaces to the trim edges.

name: ShrinkWrap
description: Wraps a new mesh around the selected objects at a target edge length, with offset, smoothing and hole filling.

name: Silhouette
description: Creates curves along the silhouette of selected objects as seen from the active view.

name: SimplifyCrv
description: Replaces curves with simpler ones, such as lines or arcs, when they match within tolerance.
menu: Curve | Curve Edit Tools > | Simplify Lines and Arcs

name: Sketch
description: Draws a freehand curve by dragging the mouse, fitted to the sampled points.
menu: Curve | Free-Form > | Sketch | Sketch on Surface | Sketch on Polygon Mesh

name: Slab
description: Makes slabs from closed planar curves with an offset distance and a height.

name: Slide
description: Slides a picked SubD vertex toward a target point along its best-aligned edge.

name: Smash
description: Flattens surfaces into a plane, with options to explode and label the pieces.
menu: Surface > | Surface Flattening > | Smash Double-Curved Surface

name: Smooth
description: Smooths objects by moving points toward their neighbors by a smoothing factor.

name: Snap
description: Toggles grid snap, with options to apply it to all viewports.

name: Snapshots
description: Saves, restores, deletes or lists named restore points of the whole document.

name: SnapSize
description: Sets the grid snap size.

name: SnapToLocked
description: Toggles whether object snaps include locked objects.

name: SnapToMeshes
description: Toggles whether End, Vertex and Near snaps include mesh vertices and edges.

name: SnapToMeshObject
description: Toggles whether object snaps include mesh objects at all.

name: SnapToOccluded
description: Toggles whether snaps can pick points hidden behind other objects.

name: SnapToSubDObject
description: Toggles whether object snaps include SubD control-net vertices.

name: SoftEditCrv
description: Moves a point on a curve and smoothly drags nearby parts of the curve within a falloff distance.
menu: Curve | Curve Edit Tools > | Soft Edit

name: SoftEditSrf
description: Moves a surface point and drags nearby control points within a radius with a cosine falloff.
menu: Surface | Surface Edit Tools > | Soft Edit

name: SoftMove
description: Moves objects with a smooth falloff, so parts near the picked point move most.

name: SoftTransform
description: Turns on soft transforms, which move selected points with a smooth falloff over a radius.

name: SolidPtOn
description: Shows control points on the selected polysurfaces.

name: Sphere
description: Creates a sphere from a center and a radius or diameter.

name: SphereTangentToThreeSurfaces
description: Finds a sphere that is tangent to three picked surfaces by iteratively solving for its center and radius.

name: Spiral
description: Draws a spiral from an axis, radii and number of turns or pitch.

name: Split
description: Splits curves with curves or points, and solids with a plane through two points or a cutting surface or solid.
toolbars: Curve Drawing, Geometry Fix, Main, Main2, Solids Sidebar, SubD Sidebar, Surface Sidebar

name: SplitDisjointMesh
description: Separates each mesh into one object per disconnected part.
menu: Mesh | Mesh Repair Tools > | Split Disjoint Mesh

name: SplitEdge
description: Splits a polysurface edge at a picked point, cutting the edge and its trims exactly there.
menu: Surface and Analyze | Edge Tools > | Split Edge

name: SplitFace
description: Splits a picked face where a picked curve crosses its surface.
menu: Solid | Solid Edit Tools > | Faces > | Split Face

name: SplitMeshEdge
description: Splits the mesh edge nearest a pick at its midpoint.
menu: Mesh | Mesh Repair Tools > | Split Edge

name: SplitMeshWithCurve
description: Splits a mesh using the plane of a cutting curve, or a line extruded along the construction plane normal.

name: SplitRefitSurface
description: Splits target surfaces at each crossing with a curve or plane cutter and refits the pieces.

name: SplitViewportHorizontal
description: Splits the active viewport into two viewports stacked top and bottom.

name: SplitViewportVertical
description: Splits the active viewport into two viewports side by side.

name: Splop
description: Places a copy of objects at each picked point on a surface, oriented to the surface normal there.

name: Spotlight
description: Adds a spotlight from a base, a direction and a cone angle.

name: Squish
description: Flattens surfaces or meshes into a plane with minimal distortion and reports the distortion.
menu: Surface > | Surface Flattening > | Squish Double-Curved Surface

name: SquishBack
description: Maps curves or points drawn on a flattened Squish result back onto the original 3D surface.

name: SquishInfo
description: Reprints a flattened mesh's area before and after and its maximum and average distortion.

name: SrfControlPtGrid
description: Builds a surface whose control-point grid is the picked points.

name: SrfPt
description: Makes a surface spanning three or four picked corners.
toolbars: Main, Main1, Surface Creation, Surface Sidebar

name: SrfPtGrid
description: Creates a surface that passes through a grid of picked points.

name: SrfSeam
description: Moves the seam of a closed surface by rotating its knot vector.
menu: Surface | Surface Edit Tools > | Adjust Closed Surface Seam

name: STEPTree
description: Reads a STEP file into a scratch document and reports a summary of its contents.

name: StepUnitsAndTolerance
description: Reports the fixed unit and tolerance policy used for STEP files.

name: Stitch
description: Joins two picked SubD edges or vertices together.

name: Stretch
description: Stretches objects between a start and end point by a set length, with rigid and copy options.

name: SubCrv
description: Keeps only the portion of a curve between two picked points.

name: SplitSubD
description: Cuts a SubD with a vertical plane into two capped SubDs, with an option to refine the cage first.

name: SubDBox
description: Creates a SubD box from base corners and height.

name: SubDCone
description: Creates a SubD cone from a base circle and a height.

name: SubDCorner
description: Pins picked vertices on a crease or boundary as sharp corners.

name: SubDCrease
description: Marks selected SubD edges as creases so they stay sharp.

name: SubDCreaseSymmetric
description: Creases each picked SubD edge and its mirror or rotated partner edges, and repairs one-sided creases.

name: SubDCylinder
description: Creates a SubD cylinder from a base circle and a height.

name: SubDDisplayToggle
description: Toggles between the SubD surface and its control cage in the display.

name: SubDEllipsoid
description: Creates a SubD ellipsoid from a center and three semi-axis end points.

name: SubDExpandEdges
description: Replaces picked SubD edges with a strip of faces of a given width.

name: SubDFaceEdgeVertexToggle
description: Cycles the sub-object pick filter among faces, edges and vertices.

name: SubDivide
description: Subdivides selected SubDs, adding faces by one level of refinement.

name: SubDLoft
description: Lofts a SubD surface through selected curves in order.

name: SubDMoveSymmetric
description: Moves a SubD control vertex together with its mirror or rotated partners so the cage stays symmetric.

name: SubDMultiPipe
description: Runs MultiPipe on the selected curves and converts the result to SubD.

name: SubDPlane
description: Creates a flat SubD plane from two corner points.

name: SubDRemoveCorner
description: Releases picked pinned corners back to ordinary crease vertices.

name: SubDRemoveCreaseSymmetric
description: Smooths each picked creased SubD edge together with its mirror or rotated partner edges.

name: SubDRevolve
description: Runs Revolve on a profile curve and converts the result to SubD.

name: SubDSculpt
description: Drags a SubD control vertex to a new point, with nearby vertices following within a radius by a falloff.

name: SubDSculptStroke
description: Drags a SubD control vertex through a series of picks like a brush, with falloff centered on its current position.

name: SubDSphere
description: Creates a SubD sphere from a center and a radius.

name: SubDSpinEdge
description: Spins picked SubD edges one corner, clockwise or counterclockwise, around their two faces.

name: SubDSweep1
description: Runs Sweep1 along one rail and converts the result to SubD.

name: SubDSweep2
description: Runs Sweep2 along two rails and converts the result to SubD.

name: SubDSymmetryCheck
description: Reports whether a SubD cage is mirror or rotationally symmetric, with counts of unpaired vertices and crease mismatches.

name: SubDTorus
description: Creates a SubD torus from a center and two radii.

name: SubDTruncatedCone
description: Creates a SubD truncated cone from a base point, base radius, top radius and height.

name: SubDUnfriend
description: Respaces interior knots by chord length so a SubD-friendly object is no longer uniform.

name: SubDVertexInfo
description: Reports each picked SubD vertex's class, valence, faces, crease edges and limit-surface point.

name: Sun
description: Turns the sun on or off and sets its azimuth and altitude.

name: SwapMeshEdge
description: Swaps the interior mesh edge nearest a pick to join the opposite corners of its two faces.
menu: Mesh | Mesh Repair Tools > | Swap Edge

name: SwapView
description: Swaps the camera and display mode of the active viewport with the next viewport.

name: Sweep1
description: Sweeps cross-section curves along one rail curve to build a surface.

name: Sweep2
description: Sweeps cross-section curves along two rail curves to build a surface.

name: Symmetry
description: Makes a mirrored copy that stays linked to its source and updates when the source changes.

name: Synchronize Views
description: Makes parallel viewports take the active view's center and scale.
menu: View / Viewport title | Set Camera > | Synchronize Views

name: SynchronizeCPlanes
description: Applies the active viewport's construction plane to every viewport.

name: SynchronizeRenderColors
description: Sets the render colors of selected objects to match their display colors.

name: SystemInfo
description: Prints the Dino 8 version and details of the machine and graphics system.

name: Taper
description: Narrows or widens objects progressively along an axis, with flat and rigid options.

name: Text
description: Creates text from a typed string at a picked point.

name: TextObject
description: Creates text from a typed string at a picked point as outline curves, surfaces or solids, with height and thickness options.

name: TextProperties
description: Edits the text and height of selected annotations and rebuilds their outlines.

name: Textures
description: Opens the Textures panel.

name: ThicknessAnalysis
description: Colors each point of an object by the distance through the object along its inward normal.

name: ThicknessAnalysisOff
description: Turns off thickness false-color shading.

name: TiltView
description: Tilts the view sideways by 15 degrees by default, or by a typed angle.
menu: View / Viewport title | Set Camera > | Tilt View

name: ToggleFloatingViewport
description: Switches the active viewport between a docked panel and a separate floating window.

name: ToggleLeftSidebar
description: Shows or hides the left sidebar.

name: ToggleRenderMesh
description: Shows or hides the render mesh on the selected objects, or on all objects when none is selected.

name: ToggleRightSidebar
description: Shows or hides the right sidebar.

name: ToNURBS
description: Converts meshes and SubDs to NURBS polysurfaces; SubDs convert by evaluating their limit surface.

name: ToolbarLock
description: Toggles disabling the toolbar's right-click customize menu.

name: Torus
description: Creates a torus from a center, a ring radius and a tube radius.

name: ToSubD
description: Converts selected meshes or polysurfaces to SubD, using the mesh or surface control structure.

name: TriangulateMesh
description: Converts the faces of selected meshes to triangles, with a planarity option for quads.

name: TriangulateNonPlanarQuads
description: Splits quad faces that are not flat into two triangles.

name: TriangulateRenderMeshes
description: Converts the quads of selected meshes to triangles; the app has no separate render mesh.

name: Trim
description: Trims curves where they cross other curves, including apparent intersections.
toolbars: Geometry Fix, Surface Tools, Curve Drawing, Geometry Fix, Main, Main1, Solids Sidebar, Surface Sidebar
menu: Surface | Surface Edit Tools > | Untrim | Detach Trim

name: TruncatedCone
description: Creates a truncated cone from a base point, base radius, top radius and height.

name: TruncatedPyramid
description: Creates a truncated pyramid from a base point, base size, top size and height.

name: Tube
description: Creates a hollow tube from a base circle, a height and a wall thickness.

name: Turntable
description: Builds a turntable camera animation around the model and plays it once.
menu: View / Viewport title | Set Camera > | Turntable

name: Tutorials
description: Opens the Help panel.
menu: Help | Learn > | Tutorial and Samples | Window | Panels > Tutorials

name: TweenCurves
description: Creates a chosen number of curves interpolated between two selected curves.

name: TweenSurfaces
description: Creates a chosen number of surfaces interpolated between two selected surfaces.

name: Twist
description: Twists objects around an axis by an angle that grows along the axis.

name: Undo
description: Reverses the most recent change to the document.

name: UndoMultiple
description: Opens a panel to undo several recent changes at once.

name: UndoSelected
description: Undoes the most recent recorded change that affected the selected object.

name: UndoView
description: Returns the active viewport to its previous view in the view-change history.
toolbars: Render Sidebar, Set View, Standard, View

name: Ungroup
description: Dissolves the selected groups, leaving their member objects.

name: UngroupAll
description: Dissolves every group in the document.

name: UnifyMeshNormals
description: Flips mesh faces as needed so all face normals point consistently.
menu: Mesh | Mesh Repair Tools > | Unify Normals

name: Unisolate
description: Makes every object in the document visible again.

name: UnisolateLock
description: Unlocks the objects locked by IsolateLock.

name: UnjoinEdge
description: Splits a shared polysurface edge into two separate edges, so the adjacent faces are no longer joined there.

name: Unlock
description: Unlocks every locked object.
toolbars: Lock, Visibility, SubD Sidebar, Popup, Standard

name: UnlockSelected
description: Unlocks the selected objects.

name: UnpackTextures
description: Copies the textures that materials reference into a chosen folder and repoints the materials at the copies.

name: UnrollSrf
description: Flattens a developable surface or polysurface into a plane, with options to explode and label.
menu: Surface | Surface Flattening > | Unroll Developable Surface

name: UnrollSrfUV
description: Flattens surfaces into a plane, with explode and label options; shares the UnrollSrf implementation.
menu: Surface | Surface Flattening > | Unroll Developable Surface

name: Untrim
description: Removes picked trim curves from a face, restoring more of its underlying surface.
toolbars: Geometry Fix, Surface Tools, Curve Drawing, Geometry Fix, Main, Main1, Solids Sidebar, Surface Sidebar

name: UntrimAll
description: Removes every trim from the selected trimmed surfaces.

name: UntrimBorder
description: Removes only the outer border trim from picked faces.

name: UntrimHoles
description: Removes the inner hole trims from picked faces.

name: Unweld
description: Gives mesh faces separate vertices where the angle between them exceeds a tolerance.

name: UnweldEdge
description: Separates the vertices along the mesh edge nearest a pick.

name: UnweldVertex
description: Separates the mesh vertex nearest a pick into one vertex per face.

name: Unwrap
description: Creates a flat mesh of a surface's U-V rectangle or a textured mesh's texture coordinates; it does not preserve edge lengths on curved surfaces.

name: UpdateClippingDrawings
description: Redraws existing clipping drawings from their clipping planes' current section curves.

name: UseExtrusions
description: Reports that Dino 8 always stores extruded geometry as ordinary surfaces, so the setting has no effect.

name: UVEditor
description: Opens the UV editor panel, or lists mapping information on the command line.

name: VariableBlendSrf
description: Builds a blend surface between two surfaces whose tangency varies along the join.
menu: Surface | Variable Fillet/Chamfer/Blend > | Variable Blend Surfaces

name: VariableChamferSrf
description: Creates a ruled bevel surface between two surfaces with a distance that varies from start to end.
menu: Surface | Variable Fillet/Blend/Chamfer > | Variable Chamfer Surfaces

name: VariableFilletSrf
description: Creates a fillet between two surfaces with a radius interpolated from a start to an end value.
menu: Surface | Variable Fillet/Blend/Chamfer > | Variable Fillet Surfaces

name: VariableOffsetSrf
description: Offsets a surface by a distance varying linearly between two values from its U minimum edge to its U maximum edge.

name: ViewCaptureToClipboard
description: Copies the active viewport's latest rendered image to the system clipboard.

name: ViewCaptureToFile
description: Writes a picture of the active viewport to an image file.

name: ViewClippingSections
description: Aims a viewport to look squarely at each clipping plane's section.

name: ViewFirstFrame
description: Applies the first frame of the animation to the view.

name: ViewFrameNumber
description: Applies a given animation frame number to the view.

name: ViewLastFrame
description: Applies the last frame of the animation to the view.

name: ViewNextFrame
description: Applies the next animation frame to the view.

name: ViewportTabs
description: Shows or hides the tabs for switching between viewports.

name: ViewPreviousFrame
description: Applies the previous animation frame to the view.

name: Volume
description: Reports the volume of selected closed solids.

name: VolumeCentroid
description: Reports the volume centroid of selected closed solids.

name: VolumeMoments
description: Reports the volume moments of selected closed objects.

name: WalkAbout
description: Starts a first-person walk-through mode for moving the camera through the model.

name: WebBrowser
description: Opens a web page in the default browser.
menu: Tools | Web Browser | Window | Panels > Web Browser

name: Weight
description: Sets the weight of a picked control point, making the object rational if needed, or of all points on Enter.

name: Weld
description: Welds mesh vertices at edges whose angle is under a tolerance, giving smooth shading across them.

name: WeldEdge
description: Welds the duplicate vertices at both ends of the mesh edge nearest a pick.

name: WeldVertices
description: Welds every coincident vertex of the selected meshes.

name: What
description: Prints a detailed description of each selected object.

name: WindowLayout
description: Restores a saved window layout by name; WindowLayout List shows the saved ones.

name: WireCut
description: Cuts solids along a line, keeping one piece and discarding the other.
menu: Solid | Solid Edit Tools > | Wire Cut

name: Worksession
description: Attaches, detaches, lists, saves, loads or reloads reference models, copied in as locked objects.

name: Zebra
description: Turns on zebra-stripe analysis of surface reflection and continuity.

name: ZebraOff
description: Turns off zebra-stripe analysis.

name: Zoom
description: Changes the view magnification: window, all, extents, selected or dynamic.
toolbars: Popup, Render Sidebar, Set View, Standard, View
menu: View | Zoom | Viewport title | Pan, Zoom, and Rotate | Layout title | Zoom | Detail title | Pan, Zoom, and Rotate

name: Zoom1To1Calibrate
description: Calibrates the screen so a 1:1 zoom shows objects at their true physical size.

name: ZoomEnds
description: Zooms to curve endpoints that do not coincide with another curve's endpoint.

name: ZoomLens
description: Sets the camera lens length in millimeters.

name: ZoomNaked
description: Zooms to every naked edge of surfaces, meshes and polysurfaces.

name: ZoomNonManifold
description: Zooms to meshes with at least one edge shared by more than two faces.
